Name: Halloween Crops Bundle
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][b][center][font=Times New Roman]~ HAPPY HALLOWEEN ~[/font][/center][/b]
[/size]
[size=4]Happy halloween~
[/size]Thought it would be fun to make some crops inspired in Halloween for when fall comes! So here are seven new crops, hope you love them!!

[list]
[*][b]Devil's Blood[/b]: it'll grow into some cute devilish horns~
[/list]        - I also have another mod named "Devilish Horns", which has five demon horns you can use as hats!

[list]
[*][b]Candy Corn[/b]: What's Halloween without candy corn?
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Candy Eyes[/b]: Who doesn't love these candies?!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Sour Pop[/b]: For sour lovers!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Ghostly Flower[/b]: ???
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Witchy Moon Flower[/b]: Personal Favorite <3 a purple moon <3
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Ghost Bait[/b]: Maybe if you let it stay in the floor... A ghost will appear? [i](Honestly loved this one too much to sell it)[/i]
[/list][i]
[u]I've been warned that the candy corn can be an issue, since there are some other mods that already do have it. So if it's causing any issue, simply remove both folders with "Candy corn" name.[/u][/i]

[i][b]Remember the crops are only for fall!

[/b][/i][center][u]Let me know if I should do a version that allowed to plant the crops in any season,
or any requests for new crops! I'll be pleased to hear![/u][/center]
[size=5][i][b][center]· DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS ·[/center][/b]


[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]

[b]
[i][size=4][u]By:  ~ Luna ~[/u][/size][/i][/b]
